description: Z.AI (GLM models) developer content source registry. docs.z.ai serves a compact llms.txt with direct .md links, a matching sitemap.xml, and an explicit AI-scraping-friendly robots.txt (Content-Signal: ai-train=yes). Output paths below are relative to content/zai/.

docs.z.ai.notes: 68 pages via llms.txt (direct .md links), 67 via sitemap.xml -- effectively the same set, so llms.txt is used directly rather than the sitemap. Sections: guides/ (27), devpack/ (18), api-reference/ (18), legal-agreement/ (3), release-notes/ (1), help/ (1).

sources.name: zai-docs
sources.notes: Direct .md links out of llms.txt, same pattern as code.claude.com. GLM model guides, API reference, SDKs (Python/Java/OpenAI-compat/LangChain), devpack, release notes.

sources.name: zai-github-skills
sources.notes: zai-org (formerly THUDM) is mostly model-weights/inference-code repos, not doc-cookbook-dense like openai/openai-cookbook. GLM-skills is the one repo that's primarily markdown skill definitions -- other repos (GLM-OCR, ChatGLM-6B, etc.) were checked and skipped as out of scope for a docs archive.
